notes.subject: אנוש/רמה · בן אדם/תולעה
notes.rationale: Parallel pairs: mortal/maggot, son of man/worm — two different Hebrew worm-words sharpen the descent from humanity to corruption.

notes.subject: אנוש
notes.rationale: Rendered 'man i save dai' (mortal) to keep the word's core sense of frailty, not just 'man'.

notes.subject: אף כי
notes.rationale: Hebrew a fortiori particle pair compressed into one Tok Pisin phrase 'hamas moa'.

translation: Hamas moa man i save dai — em i magot; na pikinini bilong man — em i kruk bilong graun.
